column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules for Keyfleet, read by zap-baseline.sh (zap-baseline.py -c).
# Tab separated: rule id, level, (rule name), and the reason shown in the report.
# A rule not listed here warns. IGNORE is used only where the code shows the finding
# is intended; FAIL only where the code guarantees the opposite on every answer.
# Informational rules about how the site is built, not about a weakness.

column4: Informational: the pages are Phoenix LiveView, which draws links with JavaScript.
Informational: fingerprinted assets are cached a year on purpose (endpoint.ex Plug.Static); pages are private, max-age=0.

column1: # The content security policies are intended as written (lib/keyfleet_web/content_security_policy.ex):
# sign-in pages allow style-src 'unsafe-inline' because Privy's window writes style elements, every
# page allows style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline' for LiveView's kept style attributes, and
# https://*.rpc.privy.systems is Privy's published wildcard. The rule stays WARN, not IGNORE, because
# the same rule id would also report a script-src regression.

column4: Expected: style-src 'unsafe-inline' on sign-in pages and *.rpc.privy.systems; anything about script-src is new.

column1: # Every cookie the server sets carries all three flags: the session (config/config.exs :session_options)
# and the notebook pass (lib/keyfleet_web/plugs/notebook_gateway.ex). A cookie without one is a regression.

column4: Both server cookies are HttpOnly (config.exs session_options; notebook_gateway.ex).
Both server cookies are Secure (config.exs session_options; notebook_gateway.ex).
Both server cookies are SameSite=Lax (config.exs session_options; notebook_gateway.ex).

column1: # The agent files are public on purpose and answer with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
